# `csharp_space_before_dot`

Space before a dot.

## Values

| Value | Notes |
|---|---|
| `true` |  |
| `false` |  |

**Default:** `false`

## Conformance

No known case where Curb's output is not a fixed point of `dotnet format` — see [conformance](../../design-principles/conformance.md).

### `csharp_space_before_dot = true`

```ini
csharp_space_before_dot = true
```

::::{tab-set}

:::{tab-item} Before
```csharp
using System.Text;

namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Build()
    {
        return new StringBuilder().Append("Hello").Append(", ").ToString();
    }
}
```
:::

:::{tab-item} After
```csharp
using System.Text;

namespace N;

public class Widget
{
    public string Build()
    {
        return new StringBuilder().Append("Hello").Append(", ").ToString();
    }
}
```
:::

::::

using System.Text;
